session_1.speaker: Mira
session_1.text: Tobias, I finally planted basil and thyme on my balcony.

session_1.speaker: Tobias
session_1.text: Nice! I repaired my old tandem bicycle yesterday.

session_1.speaker: Mira
session_1.text: Does the tandem have a bell? Mine would need a red one.

session_1.speaker: Tobias
session_1.text: It has a green bell shaped like a frog.

session_1.speaker: Mira
session_1.text: I will water the thyme every morning at seven.

session_1.speaker: Tobias
session_1.text: I will test the bicycle on Sunday near the river.

session_2.speaker: Tobias
session_2.text: The river ride was great, we passed a lighthouse.

session_2.speaker: Mira
session_2.text: My basil grew tall, but the thyme turned yellow.

session_2.speaker: Tobias
session_2.text: Maybe it needs more sun. I bought a lamp for my workshop.

session_2.speaker: Mira
session_2.text: I am planning a trip to Lisbon in September.

session_2.speaker: Tobias
session_2.text: Bring a camera, the tiles there are famous.

session_2.speaker: Mira
session_2.text: I will pack my blue camera bag.

session_1.speaker: Odile
session_1.text: Ravi, my first pottery class is on Tuesday.

session_1.speaker: Ravi
session_1.text: I threw a lopsided bowl last week, it was glazed teal.

session_1.speaker: Odile
session_1.text: I want to make mugs with a wide handle.

session_1.speaker: Ravi
session_1.text: My kiln firing takes nine hours.

session_1.speaker: Odile
session_1.text: The studio is on Maple Street.

session_1.speaker: Ravi
session_1.text: I will bring you the teal bowl as a gift.

session_2.speaker: Ravi
session_2.text: Your mug turned out beautiful, the handle is perfect.

session_2.speaker: Odile
session_2.text: Thank you! I signed up for the advanced class.

session_2.speaker: Ravi
session_2.text: I am going to a ceramics fair in Porto next month.

session_2.speaker: Odile
session_2.text: Please buy me a small ocarina made of clay.

session_2.speaker: Ravi
session_2.text: Sure, I will look for a yellow one.

session_2.speaker: Odile
session_2.text: The advanced class starts in June.
